defs.def: to make sth go or be taken to a place, especially by post/mail, email, radio, etc. 邮寄；发送

ex.s: My heart raced when I saw the email sender’s name.
ex.t: 当我看到邮件发件人的名字时，我的心跳加速了。

ex.s: How did the author feel upon seeing the email sender’s name?
ex.t: 看到邮件发件人的名字时，作者是什么感受？

ex.s: Morse invented a code for sending messages over an electromagnetic circuit.
ex.t: Morse发明了一种通过电磁电路发送信息的编码。

ex.s: Once the registration form is received and processed, we will send a confirmation email within two business days.
ex.t: 一旦收到并处理注册表，我们将在两个工作日内发送确认邮件。

ex.s: Sending smiling faces to colleagues may seem strange
ex.t: 给同事发送笑脸表情似乎很奇怪。

ex.s: The unwilling parent organizes the meal schedule, sends out emails, and collects money for end-of-season gifts.
ex.t: 那位不情愿的家长安排用餐时间表、发送电子邮件，并为赛季末礼物筹集资金。

ex.s: Invitation Traditionally, people send written invitations for formal events such as weddings.
ex.t: 邀请函 传统上，对于婚礼等正式活动，人们会发送书面邀请函。

defs.def: to tell sb sth by sending them a message 传达；转致；告知

ex.s: If the information you’re communicating isn’t urgent, consider sending an email.
ex.t: 如果你传达的信息并不紧急，考虑发一封邮件。

ex.s: He likes to think of sending postcards as a family-friendly hobby.
ex.t: 他喜欢把寄明信片看作一种适合全家的爱好。

ex.s: After becoming an important part of many British streets, the phone boxes began disappearing in the 1980s, with the rise of the mobile phone sending most of them away to the junkyards.
ex.t: 在成为许多英国街道的重要组成部分后，电话亭从20世纪80年代开始逐渐消失，随着手机的兴起，大多数被送进了垃圾场。

ex.s: sending a needed book to a library branch nearby
ex.t: 把需要的书送到附近的图书馆分馆

ex.s: "There is a lot of really interesting evidence which seems to be suggesting that if children are inspired up to the age of seven, then being outdoors will be a habit for life." His own children have got into the habit of playing outside now: "We just send them out into the garden and tell them not to come back in for a while."
ex.t: “有大量非常有趣的证据似乎表明，如果孩子在七岁前受到启发，那么待在户外将成为一生的习惯。”他自己的孩子现在也养成了在外面玩的习惯：“我们只是把他们赶到花园里，告诉他们一会儿别回来。”

defs.def: to tell sb to go somewhere or to do sth; to arrange for sb to go somewhere 派遣；打发；安排去

ex.s: It is calculated that European railways alone spend approximately 20 billion euros a year on maintenance, including sending maintenance staff, often at night, to inspect and repair the rail infrastructure.
ex.t: 这可能是危险的工作，如果有无人机协助工作人员就可以避免这种危险。

defs.def: to make sth/sb move quickly or suddenly 使快速（或猛然）移动
to make sb behave or react in a particular way 使作出（某种反应）；使表现出（某种行为）
to send sb to prison 判（某人）入狱

ex.s: Whenever I heard of businesses using plastic, I'd send an email.
ex.t: 每当我听说有企业使用塑料，就发一封邮件。

ex.s: I let my line drawings turn into cartoons I send to friends.
ex.t: 我让我的线条画变成漫画发给朋友们。

ex.s: they send emails in errorB. they fail to work interactively
ex.t: 他们发错了邮件B. 他们未能互动合作

ex.s: Why did the author decide to send Spot and Stripe back to the zoo?
ex.t: 作者为什么决定把斯波特和斯特赖普送回动物园？

ex.s: Instead of walking a few blocks to pick up a child or the dry cleaning, they send the self-driving minibus.
ex.t: 他们不是步行几个街区去接孩子或取干洗的衣服，而是派出自动驾驶小巴。

ex.s: So if we send out a robot with the single instruction of fetching coffee, it will have a strong desire to secure success by disabling its own off switch or even killing anyone who might interfere with its task.
ex.t: 所以，如果我们派出一个只接到“去取咖啡”这一指令的机器人，它会强烈渴望通过 disable 自己的关闭开关、甚至杀死任何可能干扰其任务的人来确保成功。

ex.s: Please send me a postcard!
ex.t: 请给我寄一张明信片！

defs.def: to order a student to leave a university because of bad behaviour 开除；勒令退学
to send sth to a place so that it arrives before you get there 先期发运（或送达）

ex.s: "I often send postcards to family and friends." he says to China Daily, "but you can imagine that after a while, you never receive as many as you send, and you realize that not everyone is into it   32   ” Seeking other like-minded souls, however, Paulo started looking in a somewhat unlikely place: online.
ex.t: “我经常给家人和朋友寄明信片，”他对《中国日报》说，“但你可以想象，过一阵子后，你收到的永远不会和你寄出的一样多，你会意识到不是每个人都像你一样热衷于它____32____”不过，为了寻找其他志同道合的人，保罗开始在一个不太可能的地方寻找：网上。

ex.s: When your boss or professor sends you out to do man-on-the-street interviews for a story, think about the topic and develop a list of about ten general questions relating to it.
ex.t: 当你的老板或教授派你出去为一篇报道做街头采访时，先想想主题，并就此列出大约十个相关问题。

ex.s: The head of the language school told the local newspaper that the school is going to send Harvold on a weekend   53    to Dublin with a friend, thanking him for his    54   .
ex.t: 这所语言学校的校长告诉当地报纸，学校将送哈沃德在周末____53____与一位朋友去都柏林，并感谢他的____54____。

ex.s: They're going to send them to us when they get back home.
ex.t: 他们回家后会寄给我们

ex.s: So, I called Directory Assistance, got put through to our landlady’s managing agent, and had a spare key sent to me with just enough time to get back in before the actors arrived.
ex.t: 于是我打了查号台，转接到房东的代理处，让人送了一把备用钥匙过来，刚好能在演员到达之前赶回去开门。

ex.s: SILENCE in big black letters was on signs hung everywhere If she thought you were dressed improperly, she sent you straight back home to change your clothes.
ex.t: 用大写字母写的"安静"标志到处都是如果她觉得你穿得不合适，她会直接让你回家换衣服。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

defs.def: to send a letter that has been sent to sb's old address to their new address 转寄，转投（信件）

ex.s: They sent a mail to their neighbors.
ex.t: 他们给邻居寄了信。

ex.s: They sent a mail to their neighbors.
ex.t: 他们给邻居寄了信。

ex.s: A friend has been sending me articles on how quantum computers might help solve some of the biggest challenges we face as humans.
ex.t: 一位朋友一直在给我发文章，介绍量子计算机可能如何帮助我们解决作为人类所面临的一些最大挑战。

ex.s: Little do they know that as they do so, a burst of energy is sent up to street level to help charge an electric car.
ex.t: 他们几乎不知道，在这么做的同时，一股能量被传送到街道层面，用来给一辆电动汽车充电。

ex.s: In the past year, Detrinidad sent out more than 70,000 plants.
ex.t: 在过去一年中，德特里尼达德送出了超过70,000株植物。

ex.s: Shortly after I received his invitation, applications to join the Youth for Nature and the Youth for Planet groups were sent around through my high school.
ex.t: 不久，我收到了他的邀请，申请加入 " 青年为自然 " 和 " 青年为星球 " 团体 通过我的高中。

ex.s: Some of its rhinos may be sent to the protected wild areas.
ex.t: 它的一些犀牛可能被送往受保护的野外区域。

ex.s: “You know that big box of corn Uncle John sent us?
ex.t: 你知道 John 叔叔送给我们的那大箱玉米吗？

ex.s: When he went home, he sent Benjamin a box of paint and some brushes.
ex.t: 回家后，他给本杰明寄了一盒颜料和一些画笔。

ex.s: He sent him to a school in Philadelphia.
ex.t: 他把他送到费城的一所学校。

defs.def: to send sth from one place/person to another 转送；转递；转达
to send sth to a lot of different people or places 分发；散发
to produce sth, such as light, a signal, sound, etc. 发出（光、信号、声音等）

ex.s: Because the moon’s body blocks direct radio communication with a probe, China first had to put a satellite in orbit above the moon in a spot   63   it could send signals to the spacecraft and to Earth.
ex.t: 由于月球本体阻挡了与探测器的直接无线电通信，中国必须先在月球上方轨道上的一个___63___能将信号发往航天器和地球的位置部署一颗卫星。

ex.s: Back in 1983, two scientists, Jack Schultz and Ian Baldwin, reported that young maple trees getting bitten by insects send out a particular smell that neighboring plants can get.
ex.t: 早在1983年，两位科学家杰克·舒尔茨和伊恩·鲍德温报告说，被昆虫叮咬的幼枫树会发出一种特殊的气味，邻近的植物能够接收到。

ex.s: Back in 1983,two scientists,Jack Schultz and Ian Baldwin,reported that young maple trees getting bitten by insects send out a particular smell that neighboring plants can get.
ex.t: 早在1983年，两位科学家杰克·舒尔茨和伊恩·鲍德温报告说，被昆虫叮咬的幼枫树会发出一种特殊的气味，邻近的植物能够接收到。

ex.s: Maybe the first plant just made a cry of pain or was sending a message to its own branches, and so, in effect, was talking to itself.
ex.t: 也许第一株植物只是发出了一声痛苦的呐喊，或者是在向自己的枝干传递信息，因此实际上是在跟自己说话。

ex.t: 也许第一株植物只是发出了一声痛苦的呐喊，或者是在向自己的枝干传递信息，因此实际上是在跟自己说话。

ex.s: It sends out certain chemicals.
ex.t: 它释放某些化学物质。
